name: const unsafe fn from_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : Range < * const T >) -> & 'a [T]
rule: `range.end` must be valid and properly aligned for one past the last element, such that the offset from the end to the start pointer is the length of the slice.
api: const unsafe fn from_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : core::ops::range::Range < * const T >) -> & 'a [T]
